name: E-Commerce Defective Smartphone Refund Denial
raw_input: I ordered a Samsung Galaxy smartphone worth Rs 26,999 on an e-commerce app on 10th November 2024. It was delivered on 14th November. Within 24 hours of opening the box, the screen started flickering with green lines and touch stopped working. I raised a replacement request on 15th November. The app sent a technician for inspection on 21st November. The technician confirmed it is a manufacturing hardware defect and took sign on his job sheet. But on 23rd November, customer support cancelled my return request stating 'The 7-day return window expired on 21st November'. They are telling me to go to an authorized brand service center 40 km away. I paid for a brand new working phone, not a defective phone repaired on day one. I have the invoice, delivery receipt, technician inspection job sheet copy, and chat screenshots.

case_dossier.case_title: Defective Smartphone Delivery and Denied Replacement by E-Commerce Platform
case_dossier.summary: The user purchased a smartphone worth Rs. 26,999 which arrived with a manufacturing defect. Despite raising a return request within the window and having a technician verify the defect, the e-commerce platform cancelled the return citing the expiry of the return window and directed the user to a service center.

timeline.event: User ordered a Samsung Galaxy smartphone on the e-commerce app for Rs. 26,999.
The smartphone was delivered to the user.
Screen started flickering with green lines and touch stopped working; user raised a replacement request.
Technician inspected the phone, confirmed the manufacturing hardware defect, and had the user sign the job sheet.
Customer support cancelled the return request stating the 7-day return window expired on 21st November.

evidence_needed: Written communication or emails with the platform detailing the cancellation reason
case_dossier.evidence_strength_explanation: Strong documentary and technical proof including an official technician job sheet confirming the manufacturing defect and timely initial complaint.

escalation_check.legal_aid_contact: District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) / NALSA Toll-Free Helpline: 15100

rights_advice.plain_language_standing: You are well within your legal rights as a consumer because you reported the defect promptly and obtained an official technician verification. Under Indian law, supplying a defective product and refusing a timely replacement or refund amounts to a deficiency in service and an unfair trade practice. Your immediate takeaway is that you have strong documentary evidence—including the invoice and the technician's job sheet—to demand a full replacement or refund through consumer forums.

governing_laws.relevance: Protects you as a consumer who bought goods for consideration.
Defines product defects and deficiencies in service, holding the seller accountable for faulty goods.
Classifies unjustified refusal to refund or replace defective goods as an unfair trade practice.

action_options.title: Lodge Grievance on NCH & Send Formal Legal Notice
action_options.details: Lodge a formal complaint on the National Consumer Helpline (NCH) via toll-free number 1915 or consumerhelpline.gov.in. Simultaneously, serve a formal 15-day Legal Demand Notice to the seller and e-commerce platform detailing your technician's job sheet and purchase invoice.

action_options.title: File Electronic Complaint on e-Daakhil
action_options.details: If the platform fails to respond or redress your grievance after the notice period, file an electronic consumer complaint online on e-Daakhil (edaakhil.nic.in). Attach your purchase invoice, delivery receipt, technician inspection job sheet copy, and chat screenshots. (Note: For free legal guidance and aid, you may contact the District Legal Services Authority via Helpline 15100).

action_options.title: District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission Proceedings
action_options.details: Pursue your petition before the District Consumer Commission for formal adjudication, seeking a refund of Rs. 26,999, compensation for mental agony, and litigation costs.

rights_advice.real_lawyer_guidance: You can comfortably represent yourself in the Consumer Commission without hiring a physical advocate, as the Consumer Protection Act is designed for self-representation. However, you may consult a lawyer or contact DLSA (Helpline 15100) if you need assistance drafting your formal notice or complaint petition.
rights_advice.disclaimer: ⚠️ NyayaMitra provides legal information and self-advocacy tools under Indian laws. For formal courtroom representation, consult a licensed advocate.

### **SUBJECT: LEGAL DEMAND NOTICE FOR SUPPLYING DEFECTIVE PRODUCT, UNJUSTIFIED CANCELLATION OF RETURN REQUEST, DEFICIENCY IN SERVICE, AND UNFAIR TRADE PRACTICE UNDER THE CONSUMER PROTECTION ACT, 2019**

---

Dear Sir/Madam,

I, am a consumer residing at the address mentioned above in the sender block. I am serving this legal demand notice upon you directly, in my personal capacity, to demand the immediate replacement of the defective product supplied to me or, alternatively, a full refund of the amount paid, along with compensation for the deficiency in service and unfair trade practices committed by your platform and seller.

I hereby state and submit as under:

1. **Purchase and Delivery of the Product:** 
 On 10th November 2024, I placed an online order for a Samsung Galaxy smartphone on your e-commerce platform for a total consideration of Rs. 26,999. The said product was successfully delivered to my address on 14th November 2024.

2. **Immediate Reporting of Defect:** 
 Within 24 hours of delivery (approx. on 15th November 2024), I discovered that the smartphone suffered from a severe manufacturing defect—specifically, the screen started flickering with green lines and the touch functionality completely stopped working. Promptly upon discovering the defect, I raised a replacement request on your platform within the permitted return window.

3. **Technician Verification and Job Sheet:** 
 On 21st November 2024, an authorized technician inspected the smartphone at my location, confirmed the manufacturing hardware defect, and had me sign the official technician inspection job sheet copy. 

4. **Unjustified Cancellation of Return:** 
 Despite the technician's clear verification and my timely initial complaint, your customer support arbitrarily cancelled my return request on 23rd November 2024, stating that the 7-day return window had allegedly expired on 21st November 2024, and improperly directed me to approach a service center.

5. **Statutory Violations & Deficiencies:** 
 Your refusal to process my replacement or refund despite a confirmed manufacturing defect constitutes a direct deficiency in service and an unfair trade practice under Section 2(10), Section 2(11), and Section 2(47) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. As a consumer who purchased goods for valid consideration under Section 2(7) of the said Act, I am fully entitled to receive goods of merchantable and defect-free quality.

---

### **DEMAND FOR RECTIFICATION**

Therefore, through this notice, I call upon you to fulfill the following within **15 days** from the receipt of this notice:

1. Arrange for the immediate pickup of the defective smartphone and deliver a brand-new replacement of the same model in working condition; **OR**, in the alternative, issue a full refund of **Rs. 26,999** to my original payment source.
2. Cease and desist from engaging in unfair trade practices of rejecting valid return requests backed by your authorized technician's job sheet.

If you fail to comply with the aforesaid demands within the stipulated 15-day period, I shall be constrained to initiate formal legal proceedings against you before the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission via e-Daakhil (`edaakhil.nic.in`), and seek appropriate relief including a full refund, compensation for mental agony, and litigation costs, without any further reference to you. 

*(For free legal guidance and assistance regarding consumer rights, I may also consult the District Legal Services Authority / NALSA Toll-Free Helpline: 15100).*

Please treat this matter with the urgency it deserves.

---

Sincerely / Yours faithfully,

*(Signature)* 
[Your Name] 

---

**ANNEXURE INVENTORY (Documents Enclosed):**
1. Copy of Purchase Invoice (Rs. 26,999)
2. Copy of Delivery Receipt
3. Copy of Technician Inspection Job Sheet signed on 21st November 2024
4. Screenshots of customer support chat logs and return cancellation notification

sample_roleplay_turn.user_argument: Under Section 2(11) and Section 84 of the Consumer Protection Act 2019, delivering a defective phone and delaying inspection past your return window is a clear deficiency in service and unfair trade practice. I have the technician report confirming hardware fault. I demand an immediate refund or I will escalate to the National Consumer Helpline and e-Daakhil.

opponent_response.opponent_reply: Arre sir, why are you threatening with all these big legal terms? Look, our system shows the return window is strictly 7 days and it expired. Technician report or whatever, company policy is policy! You go to the service center and get it repaired under warranty. We cannot process a direct refund sitting here.

coach_evaluation.what_went_well: You effectively cited specific sections of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 (Section 2(11) for deficiency in service and Section 84 for product liability), and referenced the technician report.
coach_evaluation.what_to_improve: Keep up the pressure on the fact that your return request was raised *within* the valid window before they delayed it. Remind them that forcing a brand-new defective product to a service center instead of replacing it is also an unfair trade practice.
coach_evaluation.suggested_next_counter: My return request was logged well within the permitted window; running out the clock with your internal delays does not absolve your liability under Section 84 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
